$comment: slack-term language pack. Strings slack ask posts into Slack, and the patterns the choice-question hint looks for. Loaded at call time: edit and rerun, no rebuild. A .slack-term/locales/<lang>.json overrides keys here. ask.* marked WIRE are matched back exactly on questions already posted: never reword them.

ask.instructionReactionThread: _Press one of the reactions below to answer. If none fits, reply in this message's *thread* (ordinary channel posts are not picked up as answers)._
ask.instructionReactionHere: _Press one of the reactions below to answer. If none fits, reply to this message._
ask.instructionTextThread: _Reply in this message's *thread* — your reply is the answer (ordinary channel posts are not picked up as answers)._
ask.instructionTextHere: _Reply to this message — your reply is the answer._
ask.overflowNote: _Choices 11 and up have no reaction — answer them with a reply._
ask.explainLine (WIRE): Explain — press to ask the asker for more detail (not an answer)
ask.explainNote (WIRE): Explanation requested — it will follow in this thread. The question stays open; answer it after that.
ask.invalidPrefix (WIRE): _:warning: Several choices are selected, so this is not counted as an answer — keep only one:
ask.voidStamp: _Void{reason} — this question no longer takes answers._
